numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.description: ResidencyFloors is the set of floors; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

floor.description: floor is required: it applies to every change, together with every matching rule's floor.
floor.title: Residency Class

rules.description: rules add floors per component and environment; a rule never relaxes floor.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.title: Residency Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.description:
ResidencyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change, and a
 key the change has no value for counts as a match. Floors from the org and control packs all hold together.

component.description:
component is the name of the component the change touches. It is not a security boundary until floors match only
 components of an org-owned SIGNED_POLICY registry, since a repo can rename one.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.title: Residency Match

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.description: ResidencyRule adds a floor for the changes it matches.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.title: Residency Rule
